framing_note_detail: This record exposes the verbatim bytes the LSB pipeline sent and the verbatim bytes the provider returned for a single collection session. Each step is shown below as three sub-blocks: what LSB sent, what the provider returned, and any reasoning trace the provider surfaced. This record is not a transcript of the model's reasoning, intent, or understanding; it is a transcript of the LSB collection step.
